import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

    # Precompute all subpalindromes
    subpalindromes = []
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            substring = s[i:j+1]
            if substring == substring[::-1]:
                subpalindromes.append((i, j))

    # Count crossing pairs
    count = 0
    m = len(subpalindromes)
    for i in range(m):
        s1, e1 = subpalindromes[i]
        for j in range(i+1, m):
            s2, e2 = subpalindromes[j]
            if (s1 < s2 < e1 < e2) or (s2 < s1 < e2 < e1):
                count += 1

    print(count % 51123987)
